title: OthersFacts
description: Other vessels reduced to facts about self's options, per sector around self: the `others` class of a Situation (colregs-engine#82). Not vessels: a Situation stays two-vessel, and these flatten to `others:<sector>:<key>` in the predicate namespace. Every field is pencil until the reduction is written. Structure only.

sector.$comment: count: vessels in the sector other than `other`. nearest_nm: range to the nearest of them. foreclosed: whether a helm action into this sector is foreclosed by those vessels.
